label: copy phase of length-9 sequences, echoing j/u/s/v/w
explanation: Sparse reset-gate unit that fires only in the copy phase, never during original input or at <DEL>. It fires almost only on long sequences (L=9 holds 84% of mass, L=8 13%, none for L<=5). Within the copy phase it peaks at recall_idx 2 (t=L+2) and at the last two copy steps of L=9 (t=16,17). It strongly prefers fed-back input tokens j, u, s, v, w (j has 5.9x lift); e and f are weaker. The strongest activations are j near the end of L=9 copies. The predicate gets dev F1 0.34 (P 0.27, R 0.46, mass recall 0.58). Copy phase with L>=8 covers 97% of mass but has only 5% precision, so most such steps do not fire and the deciding factor is not captured. Larger magnitudes come with late copy steps and with j input, but the full magnitude pattern is not captured.
